lastCompletedStory.title: Supervisor records pattern outcomes at cycle-close

nextStoryContext: US-006 wired a `recordPatternOutcomeFn` optional dep onto `RunSidecarLoopOptions` (src/supervisor/loop.ts), fired at the SAME terminal-verdict placement as the CAM-189 SUGGESTION-filing hook (right after it, still strictly after `opts.clearActive()` and before the `flipActiveFn` auto-chain continue), on the same pair of terminal statuses ('complete' OR 'awaiting-operator'). On each fire it reads the terminal worker-report.json via `supervisorOpts.readWorkerReport()` (same reader `runSupervisor`'s own outcome detection already uses -- not yet cleared at this point in the tick), pulls `report.appliedPatternIds ?? []`, maps `result.lastOutcome?.kind` through `mapWorkerOutcomeToStatus` (src/commands/pattern-records.ts, US-003 CAM-64), and calls `opts.recordPatternOutcomeFn(recordIds, status)` exactly once ONLY when both `recordIds.length > 0` AND `status !== null` (an 'unknown'/'no-commit' kind maps to `null` and is a documented no-op, same as an empty/absent ids list or an absent lastOutcome). Wrapped in try/catch (mirrors the SUGGESTION hook's `suggestion-filing-crash-outer` pattern) logging a `sidecar-exit` event with `reason: 'pattern-outcome-crash-outer'` on any throw, so a store-write failure never wedges the terminal path. Production wiring: `makeRecordPatternOutcomeFn(cwd)` (new export in src/supervisor/host.ts) is the supervisor's ONLY call site for `appendOutcomeOnMain` -- it loops `recordIds` and calls `appendOutcomeOnMain({ cwd, recordId, status, spawnFn: realOnMainSpawnFn })` once per id, skip-and-ignore on any per-id failure (not-found/diverged/detached-head/missing-main all fail-soft, `appendOutcomeOnMain` never throws for those). `src/commands/sidecar.ts` threads the dep through exactly like `fileSuggestionsFn`: a new `SidecarOptions.recordPatternOutcomeFn` override field, a `SidecarLoopDepsResult.recordPatternOutcomeFn` field, production default `options.recordPatternOutcomeFn ?? makeRecordPatternOutcomeFn(cwd)` inside `buildSidecarLoopDeps` (wired unconditionally, both operator and auto plan_approval modes -- recording an outcome for an already-applied pattern is not an autonomy escalation), and a passthrough in `runSidecar`'s `runSidecarLoop(...)` call. This is loop.ts's ONLY reference to pattern-outcome recording: `appendOutcomeOnMain` itself is never imported or called from loop.ts, keeping the supervisor the sole writer of pattern outcomes (ADR-0035 'supervisor is the sole writer' posture, mirrored from prd.json `passes:true` writes). Test coverage landed directly in `test/supervisor/loop.test.ts` (per the story's own AC oracle naming that exact file, see the new patterns.md bullet on reading AC oracle file paths literally) in a new `describe('runSidecarLoop US-006 (CAM-64): recordPatternOutcomeFn hook at cycle-close', ...)` block: AC2 no-op matrix (dep absent, readWorkerReport null, appliedPatternIds empty/absent, lastOutcome null), a gate matrix (complete/awaiting-operator fire, blocked/max-iterations never fire), a full WorkerOutcomeKind->PatternOutcomeStatus mapping matrix (all 6 kinds, asserting the exact ids+status reaching the hook, using the REAL `mapWorkerOutcomeToStatus` rather than a duplicated literal table), a crash-survival test, an AC3 source-text guard (`appendOutcomeOnMain(` appears in host.ts only, never in loop.ts), and an AC4 real-tmpdir-git end-to-end test (seeds a real PatternRecord via `appendPatternRecordOnMain` in a fresh `git init` tmpdir repo, drives `runSidecarLoop` with the REAL `makeRecordPatternOutcomeFn(dir)` as the injected dep, then re-reads the record via `readPatternRecordsFromMain` to assert a real `{status:'success', recorded_at}` PatternOutcome landed on main -- not a mock-call tautology). At story start, `src/commands/sidecar.ts`/`src/supervisor/host.ts`/`src/supervisor/loop.ts` were ALREADY carrying this hook's production wiring uncommitted (a prior session had implemented the hook itself but not its tests or the file-size fallout) -- this story's work was primarily the test suite plus raising 4 files' `file-size-budget.json` ceilings in one `_ref` entry (`sidecar.ts` 3369->3389, `host.ts` 1071->1090, `loop.ts` 2316->2391, `loop.test.ts` 4079->4434). `scripts/cam/pattern-records.jsonl` still has zero real records on main (no producer story has run against a real project yet) -- the store's confirmationScore math (US-001) has never been exercised end-to-end outside tests. `US-006` was the last story in this PRD's dependency chain (requires: US-005); no further stories are queued as of this handoff, so the next agent should check `prd.json` for PRD-completion status rather than assuming a `US-007` exists.
